note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 4.2 ("Upon receipt of an OPEN message, a BGP speaker MUST calculate the value of the Hold Timer by using the smaller of its configured Hold Time and the Hold Time received in the OPEN message."). Positive: TestNegotiateWith_HoldTimeMinOfBoth pins local<peer (60/90->60), peer<local (90/30->30), and equal (45/45->45) on negotiateWith/publishNegotiation; open-hold-time-peer-lower-wins.ci proves end-to-end with a real daemon proposing 180s against a silent peer proposing 3s that Hold Timer Expired NOTIFICATION (4/0) fires within 20s. Negative: TestNegotiateWith_HoldTimeZero proves zero from either side yields 0 rather than the other side's non-zero value.
